name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person, the roster against the price, and the money. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Contract changes
sections.note: In New Zealand, cleaners must be told of their right to transfer 20 working days before the change (ERA 2000 s 69G).
sections.sql: select site, direction, other_contractor, takes_effect_on, tell_by, cleaners_told_on, transfer_info_on, standing from v_contract_changes where standing <> 'done' order by takes_effect_on

sections.title: Open visits, next 14 days
sections.sql: select ref, site, to_char(starts_at, 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as starts, planned_hours as hours, note from v_visits where status = 'open' and ends_at > site_now and starts_at < site_now + interval '14 days' order by starts_at

sections.title: Hours this week against the price
sections.sql: select site, client, budget_hours_week as priced, rostered_hours as rostered, open_hours as open, worked_hours as worked_so_far from v_site_week order by rostered_hours - budget_hours_week desc

sections.title: Visits breaking a rule, next 14 days
sections.sql: select p.ref, v.site, v.cleaner, to_char(v.starts_at, 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as starts, p.kind, p.problem from v_visit_problems p join v_visits v on v.id = p.visit_id where v.status = 'planned' and v.starts_at < v.site_now + interval '14 days' order by case p.kind when 'award' then 0 when 'clash' then 1 when 'contract' then 2 else 3 end, v.starts_at

sections.title: Invoices not paid
sections.sql: select i.ref, c.code as client, i.currency, i.total_cents, i.due_on, case when i.sent_on is null then 'not sent' when i.due_on < current_date then 'overdue' else 'sent' end as standing from invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.client_id where i.paid_on is null order by i.due_on

name: quality
title: Quality
subtitle: Inspections, faults, complaints and periodicals by site.

sections.title: Sites
sections.sql: select site, client, last_inspected, days_since, last_score, score_90_days, open_faults, complaints_90_days from v_site_quality order by last_score nulls first

sections.title: Faults still open
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.site, f.area, f.item, f.fix_by, case when f.fix_by < current_date then 'late' else 'open' end as standing from faults f join v_inspections i on i.id = f.inspection_id where f.fixed_on is null order by f.fix_by

sections.title: Complaints not resolved
sections.sql: select ref, site, from_name, category, summary, hours_to_respond, standing from v_complaints where standing <> 'resolved' order by received_at

sections.title: Periodicals due in the next 30 days or late
sections.sql: select site, area, task, frequency, last_done_on, due_on, days_late from v_periodicals where days_late > -30 order by days_late desc

name: margins
title: Margins
subtitle: Each site over the last 28 days: the fee earned against the hours worked at each cleaner's rate plus on-costs.

sections.title: By site, thinnest first
sections.sql: select site, client, currency, fee_28_days_cents, worked_hours, budget_hours, labour_cents, fee_28_days_cents - labour_cents as margin_cents, round(100.0 * (fee_28_days_cents - labour_cents) / nullif(fee_28_days_cents, 0))::int as margin_pct from v_site_margin order by margin_pct nulls last
